description: EC-HPF: networks, time series, raw PV data, results and code for "Error-convergence-guided hierarchical partitioned power flow with load-equivalent injection for PV-rich distribution networks is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chang Ye, Jiacheng Li (Electric Power Research Institute of State Grid Hubei Electric Power Co., Ltd., Wuhan, China). Companion data and code package for the manuscript Error-convergence-guided hierarchical partitioned power flow with load-equivalent injection for PV-rich distribution networks (EC-HPF). Everything needed to re-run or spot-check every number, table and figure in the paper is included. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
